app.name: SDLPoP Wii
app.short_description: SDLPoP (Prince of Persia port) for Nintendo Wii
app.long_description:
Nintendo Wii port of SDLPoP, an open-source port of Prince of Persia.
Supports Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube Controller and USB keyboard, as well as mods, fast-forward, screenshots, replays and replay recording.
